consumer: An engine possession/condition check (dialogue/mission-style, as in set_has_item) asking the yes/no question 'does the avatar carry >= 250 charges of water_clean?'
scope: the avatar's own carried items (wielded/worn/inventory), measured by CHARGES not item count because water_clean is count_by_charges
decisive_source: src/visitable.cpp::visitable<T>::has_amount/amount_of_internal counts matching items (not charges) capped at qty and returns whether tally == qty; the predicate's RESULT is the authority, but its charge-vs-count reach must match the goal
divergence: avatar holds a single bottle containing 300 charges of water_clean: a count-based predicate tallies 1 item (< 250) and returns false, while the true charge-based answer is true (300 >= 250)
